Description.DefaultText: Hidden fuel pool for the village's communal wood pile, measured in the same units the vanilla Fireplace burns (96 for a full hearth). Rises when fuel is stacked on the Town Wood Pile and burns down by a fixed 1 a tick (one hearth's worth a day), whatever the player does. The six village hearths no longer draw on it. The pile's own Wood Stockpile bar is a display mirror of it.
